newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish yields could reach Europe levels-Riksbank.
newsitem.headline: Swedish yields could reach Europe levels-Riksbank.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Monday that domestic long bond yields could fall to be on par with European yields as investors start to have more confidence in the country's economic policies.
"We are not yet at the stage where we have exactly the same credibility as other EU (European Union) countries," Riksbank Governor Urban Backstrom told a monetary policy seminar.
"But the pieces are gradually falling into place so that the long bond yields will be able to converge with Europe."
Backstrom was unable to say how long it would take until Sweden would reach an EU level of credibility, and thereby lower interest rates, but said the country was getting closer.
"Gradually it is starting to be time for yields to be on those levels," he said.
At 1015 GMT, the long bond yield spread to Germany amounted to 115 basis points.
